name: Mathematics of Machine Learning
description: Normed linear space, Banach space, Hilbert space, orthonormal basis, projection theorem, dual spaces, Riesz representation theorem, bounded linear operators, compact operators, spectral theorem for self-adjoint compact operators. Reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS), positive definite functions, feature maps, Gaussian probabilistic inequalities, Tikhonov-type regularization, general regularization, representer theorem, convergence analysis of empirical risk minimization, adaptive regularization parameter choice rules. Approximation by trigonometric polynomials, localized kernel approximations, neural networks, RBF neural networks, universal approximation, convergence analysis of neural networks.
